osm-amour-bistro-57203-154372.why: A sunlit Mediterranean bistro in Malcha Marg market, looking out on a banyan tree. Breakfast, wood-oven pizza, pasta and espresso by day, wine and cocktails by night.
osm-amour-bistro-57203-154372.source: Our own visit; details from the bistro's website

osm-perch-wine-coffee-bar-57200-154453.title: Perch Wine & Coffee Bar
osm-perch-wine-coffee-bar-57200-154453.why: All warm wood inside, and a lovely feel to the place. Coffee by day and wine by night, and both work.

osm-colocal-57200-154454.title: Colocal Chocolates
osm-colocal-57200-154454.why: A cozy room with amazing coffee and delicious bites to go with it.

osm-cafe-tesu-57088-154403.why: An airy, art-filled café at Essex Farms on Aurobindo Marg, open since 2017. Bright with daylight, it serves European plates alongside Indian-grown tea and coffee.
osm-cafe-tesu-57088-154403.source: Our own visit; details from the café's website

osm-yes-minister-bowling-bar-kitchen-570.title: Yes Minister
osm-yes-minister-bowling-bar-kitchen-570.why: A bar and kitchen with bowling lanes and a games room, next door to Cafe Tesu at Essex Farms. Go with a group.
osm-yes-minister-bowling-bar-kitchen-570.source: Our own visit; details from the venue's website

osm-summer-house-cafe-57105-154408.why: A two-floor café-bar in Aurobindo Place Market, all wood, easy chairs and old couches. American comfort food, a long cocktail list, and gigs in the evenings.
osm-summer-house-cafe-57105-154408.source: Our own visit; details from the café's website

osm-auro-57105-154408.title: Auro Kitchen & Bar
osm-auro-57105-154408.why: Fusion food and cocktails across a rooftop, a main room and a green terrace in Aurobindo Place Market. Techno nights after dark.
osm-auro-57105-154408.source: Our own visit; details from the bar's website

osm-tamasha-57259-154444.why: A big, lively Connaught Place restaurant on Kasturba Gandhi Marg, with a semi-covered courtyard, a large outdoor area and music. It's close to Barakhamba Road metro.
osm-tamasha-57259-154444.source: Our own visit; details from Delhi Tourism

osm-38-barracks-57266-154445.why: Billed as India's first restaurant paying tribute to the armed forces, on the Outer Circle opposite Shankar Market. North Indian food, cocktails and live music every day.
osm-38-barracks-57266-154445.source: Our own visit; details from the restaurant's website

osm-juggernaut-57259-154452.why: A vegetarian South Indian restaurant on Barakhamba Road, with coconut sweets and eggless cakes from its own pastry counter.
osm-juggernaut-57259-154452.source: Our own visit; details from the restaurant's website

osm-daryaganj-57260-154435.why: Run by the Jaggi family, who bill themselves as the inventors of butter chicken and dal makhani, so order those two.
osm-daryaganj-57260-154435.source: Our own visit; details from the restaurant's website

osm-mia-bella-57107-154388.why: Come at sunset, when the light goes down over Hauz Khas lake and the fort. If that's what you want in Delhi, don't miss it.

osm-lord-of-the-drinks-57264-154434.why: For a high-energy night right in the heart of Connaught Place.

osm-local-57260-154442.why: Huge, with something for everyone. It works as well for an office party as for a casual evening out.

osm-mount-fuji-57266-154444.why: For sushi, ramen and kimbap, with traditional Japanese seating if you want it.

osm-fig-57205-154373.title: Fig at Malcha
osm-fig-57205-154373.why: A good-looking room with plenty of gluten-free options. Save room for the baked chocolate cake.
